correctness.rationale: Recomputed Gaussian tail compression A(t) from normalized h0 and h1 and diagonalized it. The exact trace defect is V=2Q(1-Q)+tϕ(1-2Q)-(1+t²)ϕ² with ϕ=e^-t²/sqrtπ. Differentiation gives V'=ϕ[4t(1+t²)ϕ-(1+2t²)erf(t)]. For t>0 the sign is that of R(t)-L(t), L=erf(t)/(2tϕ(t))=∫_0^1 exp(t²(1-u²))du strictly increasing from 1 to infinity, R=2(1+t²)/(1+2t²) strictly decreasing from 2 to 1. Hence exactly one positive root τ, and parity gives exactly stationary set {0,+τ,-τ}; V(0)=1/2-1/π, V''(0)=2/π positive, ±τ unique global maxima with tail limits zero. Independent symbolic expansion gave V=1/2−1/π+t²/π−4t⁴/(3π)+26t⁶/(45π)+O(t^8), numerical τ≈0.748111391996, Vmax≈0.257120277198. The polyanalytic Toeplitz identification follows by substitution in prior Hermite horizontal-Fourier fiber formula; it claims only fiber trace, not a global trace.
